annotations.title: List everything wrong in the folder

description: List every problem in the served folder, or with path only in that document or under that folder: links to files, headings or blocks not there, includes that find nothing and include loops, figures their data contradicts, diagrams, charts, components and queries that fail, data that cannot be read, frontmatter that is not YAML, and declarations, fields, rules and saved views a document breaks. Use it after editing documents, given the path of what you edited, to answer which figures disagree with their data, or to find what to fix; for one block's figures in detail use folio_provenance, and for what needs the reader, ranked, folio_needs. It reveals nothing of the reader's reading. Without path it answers at once with the problems as last checked; with path it first checks what changed in that document or under that folder, never waiting on the rest. Answers {ready, checking: true while Folio is still checking changes, so the problems may be out of date - give path, or ask again, for what is current, problems: [{kind: figure, link, include, loop, diagram, chart, component, query, data, declaration, frontmatter, field, rule or view, path, line, block, severity: error or warning - absent for a problem that is neither, what, anchor: the element to land on, opens: the document showing it when another, occurrence: which of a rule's alike rows}], version: the same while the problems are}; ready false means Folio is still reading the folder - the problems then those last checked before it stopped, and with none checked before it is refused saying so - or has never checked it, so ask again shortly. A list cut to fit one answer adds omitted, how many entries each list left out, and narrow, how to ask for less.

path.description: A document, relative to the served folder or absolute under it, such as notes/plan.md, or a folder, such as notes/; omit for the whole folder
